title: Use correct audio channel for alarms and let the user choose the specific volume for it
symptom: xDrip uses the media channel for its alarms, causing other audio sources like Spotify, Youtube, etc. to get extremely loud when an alarm goes off. Users also want to set an individual volume for the alarm, preferring a level between medium and high.
cause: The thread suggests the cause is that xDrip uses the media channel for alarms instead of the alarm channel, which affects other audio volumes.
fix: The thread suggests trying the ascending volume profile as a workaround: Settings -> Alarms and Alerts -> Glucose Alerts Settings -> Alert Volume Profile. This makes the alarm start silent and gradually increase in volume over time.
evidence_quote: Would you please try the ascending volume profile? Settings -> Alarms and Alerts -> Glucose Alerts Settings ->Alert Volume Profile
